japanese_yamato_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_yamato_1
			exists = character:japanese_yamato_192
		}
		character:japanese_yamato_1 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_yamato_192 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_94
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_93
		}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_94 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_93 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_401
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_399
		}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_401 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_399 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_1318
			exists = character:japanese_fujiwara_725
		}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_1318 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_fujiwara_725 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_taira_kanmu_631
			exists = character:japanese_taira_kanmu_614
		}
		character:japanese_taira_kanmu_631 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_taira_kanmu_614 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_oe_62
			exists = character:japanese_oe_51
		}
		character:japanese_oe_62 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_oe_51 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_ariwara_10
			exists = character:japanese_ariwara_2
		}
		character:japanese_ariwara_10 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_ariwara_2 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_ki_241
			exists = character:japanese_ki_240
		}
		character:japanese_ki_241 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_ki_240 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_yuasa_5
			exists = character:japanese_yuasa_1
		}
		character:japanese_yuasa_5 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_yuasa_1 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_kudara_13
			exists = character:japanese_kudara_12
		}
		character:japanese_kudara_13 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:japanese_kudara_12 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}

		limit = {
			exists = character:japanese_tatara_1
			exists = character:korean_buyeo_32
		}
		character:japanese_tatara_1 = { save_scope_as = awow_child}
		character:korean_buyeo_32 = { save_scope_as = awow_other_mother}
		awow_assign_historic_father_as_other_mother = yes
		clear_saved_scope = awow_child
		clear_saved_scope = awow_other_mother
	}
}
